SELECT u.id,u.`name`,u.phone,u.age, u.gender,CASE WHEN u.gender='1' THEN '男' ELSE '女' END as genderName, u.birthday,u.address,u.classs,d.name as className,d1.name as gradeName, u.grade,u.create_time as createTime,u.update_time as updateTime
from user u left join sys_dictionary d on d.id=u.classs left join sys_dictionary d1 on d1.id=u.grade
and u.name=#{user.name}
order by u.create_time desc,u.update_time desc
